items.raw_excerpt: Una peculiar atracción mecánica instalada en plena plaza durante las fiestas de Alginet ha acabado saltando del programa festivo al debate político por una forma que resulta difícil de asociar, al menos a pr...
items.summary_en: A mechanical bull installed in the main square during the annual fiestas of Alginet, a small town near Valencia, Spain, drew ridicule for its oddly phallic shape. The political party VOX Alginet called the attraction an embarrassment and blamed the city council for allowing it. The oddly designed ride became one of the most talked-about moments of this year's celebrations.

items.raw_excerpt: Amsterdam gym chain Saints and Stars has been hit with more than €300,000 in fines for breaching Dutch employment laws. The biggest fine of €234,000 after labour inspectors found it hired 25 non-EU nationals without permits and had failed to check the identity of three staff. The gym was at the centre of controversy last year when city newspaper Het Parool reported that it forced cleaners from Indonesia and the Philippines to work 17 hours a day and share beds...

items.raw_excerpt: You've heard of a Bengal tiger, and maybe also a Siberian or Sumatran tiger, but only in German speaking households will you find the 'living room tiger'.
